verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated files page saying you can "read and manage persistent files" without waking compute, and its product overview lists managing files as a core capability. Official Go, Python and TypeScript SDKs exist, so file handling through the SDK is plausible but not shown with specific read/write/upload/download methods. SSH/scp copying is a separate access path and is not credited here. missing for 10: explicit SDK file read/write/upload/download API documentation, code examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
